incidents.title: ADNOC Logistics & Services Reports Crew Member Death After Attack
incidents.description: It is with great sadness that ADNOC L&S confirms that the Jordanian crew member who was unaccounted for following the attack on one of its vessels in the Strait of Hormuz on 17 November 2026 has been found deceased. We extend our deepest condolences to his family, who we are supporting at this difficult time. ...

incidents.title: Hormuz Tanker Traffic Rises This Month Even as Attacks Increase
incidents.description: Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has risen this month, according to data from Vortexa, even as attacks on vessels in the contested waterway have increased.
